learning_objective: 🎯 We will put our bright ideas onto paper and build cool crafts using simple things like paper, glue, and our little hands!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We can build pictures by cutting colored paper into squares and triangles. When we paste them together, they can become a rocket or a house!
Did you know folding flat paper can turn it into a 3D toy? This is called Origami. We can fold paper to make popping frogs and sailing boats.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Tear and Paste Cloud
fun_activity.instructions: No scissors allowed! Tear bits of white cotton or paper with your fingers and paste them onto a blue paper to make a fluffy 3D cloud.

quick_recap: ⭐ We can create amazing art by cutting shapes and pasting them together.
⭐ Folding flat paper magically turns it into awesome 3D objects.
⭐ Making crafts with our hands makes our fingers strong and smart!
